prerequisites: Basic knowledge of Technical Informatics (switching networks and sequential circuits)

learning_outcomes.text: After completing the module, students will have knowledge and experience in how simple hardware components can be designed, tested, and mapped to programmable hardware using description languages.
They understand the functionality of a simple processor and its programming in Assembler.
They have knowledge of the structure of simple computers consisting of a processor, memory, and peripherals.
They know the essential types of peripheral units.
Based on the fundamentals of Technical Informatics, students can design digital processing units and understand the functionality of simple computers.
After completing the module, students are able to design simple synchronous, digital circuits for data processing and make them executable on programmable hardware.

assessment_rules: Graded examination: Written exam, see valid study regulations. Ungraded examination: Experimental work, approximately 5 experiments in total.
